name: Aichun Beauty Magic White 7In1 Yogurt and Milk Under Arm Cream 80g
description:
It is derived from natural sources. This cream is hypoallergenic and does not irritate sensitive skin. It is free of hydroquinone and paraben. 
Enriched with multiple natural fruit extracts that help repair and tighten pores after hair removal. Moisturizes and soothes underarm skin.**It eliminates underarm odor and does not cause any irritation. 
Description 
The formula is derived from natural sources, making one of the best and safest whiteners for skin. A Bonne’ Yogurt Milk Whitening Underarm Cream is a dark spot corrector. By cleaning skin cells and softer skin. It also helps to deodorize with confidence to protection. This cream is hypoallergenic and does not irritate sensitive skin. It is free of both Hydroquinone and paraben. 
Efficacy 
Removes skin dryness. 
Removes dark spots on the skin. 
Smoothes and softens the skin 
Makes the skin look fair and radiant. 
Reduces melanin production in the elbow and knee zones 
Removes odor. 
Keeps private areas stain-free and odor-free. 
Removes dark spots on the private parts. 
Removes dark spots on the nipples. 
Removes dark spots on the armpits. 
Removes any kind of dark spots. 
Removes any dark spots on your face. 
Directions for use 
Use a proper amount of Magic White Yogurt Milk on clean skin and body every morning and night. 
For best results, use it twice a day. 
Specification 
Brand:Aichun Beauty 
Model Name:7 In 1 Yogurt Milk Whitening Underarm Cream 
Quantity:80 g 
Applied For:Skin Brightening 
Organic Type:Herbal 
Ideal Usage: All Day 
Ideal For: Women
